brief.t: START HERE: Put Roon Body's immediate 1,500-unit run on the floor schedule and send Josh firm start and completion dates now.

ACT NOW 1: Josh confirmed PLL has all inputs for the immediate Roon Body run and remains backlogged. He narrowed the urgent need to about 1,500 units and is waiting 1 calendar day for a timeline. Send: Josh, I am putting the immediate 1,500-unit run on the floor schedule now and will send you firm start and completion dates today.

ACT NOW 2: Polo container EMCU8614105 has been at Price Transfer pending customs exam since October 10, now 7 calendar days. Price Transfer asked who the broker is yesterday, and no reply or release is visible. Send: Roxi, the broker is [BROKER NAME]. Please confirm the exam status, release status, current charges, and earliest pickup time today.

ACT NOW 3: Marcello requested 500 additional TALOVA lip balms after a stockout and proof of delivery for the prior 15,000 units. No reply or resolution is visible 8 calendar days later. Send: Marcello, I am confirming stock or build timing for the additional 500 and proof of delivery for the prior 15,000 now. I will give you both answers today.

next: Recommendation: Commit Roon Body's production dates first, identify Polo's customs broker second, then close TALOVA's stockout.

Displaced: Lice Sisters stays below Act Now because Evelyn identified material gaps, but no production due date or live floor slot is verified. The assessment calls for 4 kg Polysorbate 20, 14 kg Sodium Chloride USP, 14 kg Benzyl Alcohol NF, 2 kg Peppermint EO Supreme, and 400 kg water; the salt and benzyl alcohol must match the approved sources.
Scheduled: 12 other known operational items, none confirmed urgent. The nearest verified future delivery is FedEx shipment 533066816125 on October 19.
Noise: At least 50 Outlook messages were below the operational cutoff; the result set hit the 50-message cap.

Source gaps: CRM and WhatsApp browser sessions are signed out. Purchasing returned no current records to verify broader supplier, QC, inventory, inbound, or lead-time risks. The Email lane did not return a fresh reply within the run window. Missing data is not zero.
